T: Raised in Kansas. Fed in Kansas.
D: A young man raised on a Kansas farm learns he came from the dying planet Krypton.
P: Serve the mains when Clark comes home to Martha on the farm.
S: the cornfields around the Kent farm
Corn kernels mixed with flour, egg, spring onion and paprika, fried in spoonfuls until golden, with a sour cream and chive dip.
Clark working on the fishing boat
Flathead pieces dusted in flour and paprika, fried at 180C until crisp, with lemon and tartare sauce.
the roadside bar where Clark works for a while
Salted peanuts roasted with butter and chilli, and beef jerky on the bar with cold drinks.
M: Beef chuck browned and braised at 160C for 3 hours with onion, carrot, celery and stock, potatoes added for the last hour.
Lois Lane at the Daily Planet
Chicken, avocado and bacon club sandwiches on toasted bread with mayo and tomato, cut into triangles.
W: Apples cooked with butter, sugar and cinnamon, baked in shortcrust with a lattice top at 190C for 45 minutes, with ice cream.
K: a hot afternoon on the Kansas farm
Fresh lemons squeezed with sugar syrup and cold water, in a big jug over ice with mint.

s.note: the cornfields around the Kent farm
s.how: Mix a drained can of corn with 100g flour, 2 eggs, sliced spring onions and a pinch of paprika. Fry spoonfuls in a little oil until golden on both sides. Stir chopped chives through sour cream for the dip and serve the fritters warm.

s.note: Clark working on the fishing boat
s.how: Cut 500g flathead into bite-sized pieces and dust in flour mixed with smoked paprika and salt. Fry at 180C for 3 minutes until crisp. Drain on paper and serve with lemon wedges and tartare sauce, like a meal on the deck of a trawler.

m.how: Brown a 1.5kg piece of beef chuck all over. Add a sliced onion, 3 carrots, 2 celery sticks and 500ml beef stock. Cover and braise at 160C for 3 hours, adding 800g potatoes for the last hour. Slice and serve with the juices.

w.how: Cook 6 sliced green apples with 50g butter, 100g brown sugar and a teaspoon of cinnamon until just soft, then cool. Line a pie dish with shortcrust, fill and weave a lattice top. Bake at 190C for 45 minutes and serve warm with ice cream.

d.note: a hot afternoon on the Kansas farm
d.how: Dissolve 150g sugar in 150ml hot water and cool. Squeeze 6 lemons into a big jug and add the syrup with 1.5L cold water. Add bruised mint and plenty of ice. Pour into tall glasses on the farmhouse porch.
